enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Move legs. Sleep. Lie on back. Sleep. Pull blanket. Sleep.

Wake up. Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Open bread bag. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Pour milk into glass. Turn off stove. Put eggs on plate. Take toast from toaster. Put on plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink milk. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Wait for water to boil. Pour water into mug. Add tea bag. Steep tea. Remove tea bag. Drink tea. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open closet. Take out work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office, coordinating community programs and meetings with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Answer phone. Talk to partner organization. Schedule meeting. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program details. Coordinate with colleagues. Update calendar. Make phone calls. Send emails. Print documents. File documents.

Stand up from desk. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Walk to break room. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Eat sandwich. Eat apple. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Walk back to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office, updating program schedules and preparing event materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open program schedule file. Update dates. Update times. Contact venues. Send emails. Create flyers. Print flyers. Assemble packets. Prepare name tags. Organize materials. Make phone calls. Confirm attendance. Update spreadsheet. Save file.
Stand up. Pack bag. Walk out of office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Put food on plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from table. Pick up dishes. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Rinse dishes. Apply soap. Scrub dishes. Rinse dishes. Place in rack. Turn off tap. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Throw away trash.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to plan upcoming community program events
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open calendar. Check dates. Open document. Type notes. Research venues online. Send emails. Make phone calls. Update schedule. Save file. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with the desk lamp on and reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Read. Close book. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Move legs. Sleep. Lie on back. Sleep. Pull blanket. Sleep.
